title: Count-only cleanup can delete the APK and update feed
reproduction: Run the former workflow shell using mock releases and keep_latest=0
expected: Routine cleanup must never remove a distributed asset or a channel head
observed: Old suite explicitly expected two delete calls for two releases at zero retention; no check examined the assets or preserved either channel
fix: Preview by default; only older empty mutable versioned betas can be removed. Retain all assets, stable releases, drafts and latest-beta ties. Recheck numeric release ID and metadata before deletion.
test_evidence: 24 offline scenarios exercise actual workflow shell; actionlint passed; GET-only real repository preview with keep_latest=0 found no eligible releases. No real deletion.

title: Signing-key migration advises uninstall without protecting user data
reproduction: Follow the former official-to-fork installation and troubleshooting steps or the documented production signing example
expected: Preserve an updatable installation; back up data before switching signers; provide all six required local build properties
observed: Old instructions said uninstall first and the local signing example omitted releaseSigningCertificateSha256
fix: Document in-place updates versus different signers; link backup first, exclude preferences from the promise, and list the required certificate pin
test_evidence: Compared the signed public-to-candidate upgrade in signed-upgrade.md, the backup UI and Gradle release trust checks; no uninstall performed on a user device.

title: Template directs fork users to an upstream APK
reproduction: Expand the download template with the public beta version
expected: Send users to this fork's signed release and its checksum
observed: Old template hardcoded app.adaway.org/adaway.apk irrespective of fork version
fix: Use this repository's version-specific GitHub release page
test_evidence: Read-only GitHub response verified v13.5.6b is a prerelease with AdAway_13.5.6b.apk at the documented page.

title: Blocking, import performance and support guidance misdescribe current behavior
reproduction: Compare blocking and import claims, locale instructions, and reporting links to this fork's implementation
expected: Explain which DNS traffic can be filtered, how selected subscriptions work, and where to report issues
observed: README promised every app/browser and 5000 hosts per transaction; contributor issue links went to upstream and three style section anchors were broken
fix: Describe bounded parsing, actual bulk controls, and DNS limits; correct language and backup navigation; fix support links and warn about private log content
test_evidence: Cross-checked SourceModel, SourceLoader, PrefsMainFragment, MoreFragment, Discover resources and signed journeys. Local document destinations and in-page anchors checked.
